title: rosa canina var. hirtella
intro: Rosa canina var. hirtella, commonly known as the prickly rose or hairy dog rose, is a variety of the Rosa canina species, which is a deciduous shrub native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health, boost the immune system, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. hirtella include its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and antiviral effects, which can help to protect against infections, reduce oxidative stress, and alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
